Id1.text: The city of Bangalore, founded in the state of Karnataka, India By Kempe Gowda I, is home to the Acharya Institute of Technology. Its campus with Technical Status designated by the All India Technical Council for Technical Education in Mumbai, is located at Soldevanahalli, Acharya Dr. Sarvapalli Radhakrishnan Road, Hessarghatta Main Road, Bangalore – 560090, and the institute is directed by Dr. G.P. Prabhukumar.
